description: Create GitHub issues for ALL 56 audit findings from COMPREHENSIVE_CODE_AUDIT.md. Organize by area with appropriate labels for severity and category. Each issue should have title, description with code references, severity label, and suggested fix.
steps: Create the following labels on the repository if they don't exist: 'critical', 'warning', 'recommendation', 'security', 'performance', 'deployment', 'api', 'chat', 'rag', 'auth', 'payments', 'analytics', 'seo', 'P0', 'P1', 'P2'.

Create GitHub issues for Security findings (SEC-C1 through SEC-C5, SEC-W1 through SEC-W7, SEC-R1 through SEC-R3): 15 issues total. Each with labels ['security', severity_label]. Title format: '[SEC-XX] Short description'. Body includes: file path, code snippet, impact, and suggested fix from the audit.
Create GitHub issues for Performance findings (PERF-C1 through PERF-C3, PERF-W1 through PERF-W6, PERF-R1 through PERF-R2): 11 issues total. Each with labels ['performance', severity_label].
Create GitHub issues for Deployment findings (DEPLOY-C1 through DEPLOY-C4, DEPLOY-W1 through DEPLOY-W4, DEPLOY-R1 through DEPLOY-R2): 10 issues total. Each with labels ['deployment', severity_label].
Create GitHub issues for API Correctness findings (API-C1 through API-C2, API-W1 through API-W4, API-R1 through API-R2): 8 issues total. Each with labels ['api', severity_label].
Create GitHub issues for Chat Pipeline findings (CHAT-C1 through CHAT-C3, CHAT-W1 through CHAT-W4, CHAT-R1 through CHAT-R2): 9 issues total. Each with labels ['chat', severity_label].
Create GitHub issues for RAG/Content findings (RAG-C1 through RAG-C2, RAG-W1 through RAG-W4, RAG-R1 through RAG-R2): 8 issues total. Each with labels ['rag', severity_label].
Create GitHub issues for Auth findings (AUTH-C1 through AUTH-C2, AUTH-W1 through AUTH-W4, AUTH-R1 through AUTH-R2): 8 issues total. Each with labels ['auth', severity_label].

Create GitHub issues for Payment/Workflow findings (PAY-C1, PAY-C3, plus any remaining from audit sections 8-10): Each with labels ['payments', severity_label] or ['analytics', severity_label] or ['seo', severity_label].
Create a tracking meta-issue titled '[AUDIT] Production Readiness Tracker - 56 Issues' that lists all created issues organized by priority (P0/P1/P2) with checkboxes.
acceptance_criteria: All 56 findings from the audit have corresponding GitHub issues
Each issue has appropriate severity label (critical/warning/recommendation) and area label
Each issue body contains: file reference, finding description, impact, and suggested fix
A meta-tracking issue exists linking all individual issues by priority
Labels are created on the repository for categorization
verification: Run: gh issue list --repo founder24/-kalukaliya --limit 60 to confirm issues were created
Run: gh label list --repo founder24/-kalukaliya to confirm labels exist
findings: Created 92 individual issues (#90-#181) covering all findings from COMPREHENSIVE_CODE_AUDIT.md across 10 areas: Security (15), Performance (11), Deployment (10), API (8), Chat (9), RAG (8), Auth (8), Payments (9), Analytics (9), SEO (5). Created meta-tracking issue #182 with all issues organized by priority (P0/P1/P2) with checkboxes. 16 labels created for categorization. The audit document's executive summary stated 56 findings but the actual content contained 92 unique findings across all sections.
